features.quote: Workshops throughout the morning and afternoon
features.rationale: The program lists dance workshops across the event days.

features.quote: Access to all workshops, Shows and parties
features.rationale: The full pass grants access to shows, so shows are part of the event.
The program includes daytime socials on Saturday and Sunday.
The socials take place in separate Kizomba and Latino rooms.

features.quote: CENTRAL HOTEL – SAN CRISTÓBAL SCHOOL HOTEL
features.rationale: A recommended hotel with negotiated per-person room rates is given, and accommodation is not part of the pass.
The event venue is the same school hotel where dancers are invited to stay.
